description: T-4164: do Excel for the web's pivot date filters compare whole days or date-times, and what does the x15 pivotFilter useWholeDay change? Data!A1:B7 has Date (DATE+TIME formulas, m/d/yyyy h:mm, so the builder caches them as missing) and Sales, powers of two so a sum names its set: 4/16/2024 12:00 1, 4/17/2024 0:00 2, 4/17/2024 8:00 4, 4/17/2024 18:00 8, 4/18/2024 0:00 16, 4/18/2024 6:00 32. Each sheet is one builder-v2 pivot at A3, rows Date, Sum of Sales, with one `<filter fld="0">`; the suffix is the useWholeDay the filter's x15 extension carries (N: no extension): WEqN, WEq0, WEq1 dateEqual 45399 (4/17/2024); WEqT0, WEqT1 dateEqual 45399.5 (4/17/2024 12:00); WNt0, WNt1 dateNewerThan 45399; WOe0, WOe1 dateOlderThanOrEqual 45399; WBt0, WBt1 dateBetween 45399.25 and 45399.5; WNtN, WOeN, WBtN the dateNewerThan, dateOlderThanOrEqual and dateBetween filters with no extension. Pivot cells are in the sidecar's `pivots` section; Q!A1 makes the case scored.
